basic_info.chief_complaint: Protrusion of upper teeth, consultation for correction

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Protrusion of upper teeth, consultation for correction

oral_examination.oral_examination: Protruding face type, the lower third of the face is shorter. In the permanent dentition, the left molar has a completely distal relationship, the right molar has a distal cusp-to-cusp relationship, the front teeth have a deep overbite, and the teeth are obviously worn.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly.

source_handle: Take impressions and take pictures, agree on the plan
